                                                                           (WORKSHEET – KEEP FOR YOUR RECORDS – DO NOT FILE)

Name                                                                                                                                                                                                            Social Security Number



 1 Enter amount of adjusted gross income expected in taxable year . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . 1
 2 If deductions are itemized, enter total of such deductions expected. If deductions
   will not be itemized, enter the amount from the standard deduction table . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . 2
 3 Enter amount of federal income tax liability for taxable year . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . 3
 4 Total of lines 2 and 3. . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . 4
 5 Subtract line 4 from line 1. Enter balance here . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . 5
 6 Personal exemption and dependent exemption(s) (see instructions for Forms 40 and 40NR for amounts). . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . 6
 7 Subtract line 6 from line 5. This is your estimated taxable income. . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . 7
 8 Compute tax on amount on line 7 at the following rates:
          Single or Married & Filing Separately                                    Married & Filing Jointly
    a          1st $500        . . . . . . 2%                                    1st $1000              . . . . . . 2% . . . . . . 8a
    b          Next $2500 . . . . . . 4%                                         Next $5000 . . . . . . 4% . . . . . . 8b
    c          Over $3000 . . . . . . 5%                                         Over $6000 . . . . . . 5% . . . . . . 8c
 9 Add lines 8a, 8b, 8c. Enter total here . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . .         9
10 Amount of Alabama income tax you estimate will be withheld from your wages in taxable year. Enter balance here . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . 10
11 Subtract line 10 from line 9. Enter balance here. This is your estimated tax.
   If less than five hundred dollars ($500), no estimated tax is required to be filed (see instructions) . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . 11
